name: expediter
description: Orchestrates a feature through role agents: /plan-feature and /drive-tickets (or /build-feature in one session), per-ticket /build-ticket, /build-ui-ticket and /write-docs, and a checkpoint that survives /clear.

nudge_at_tokens.title: Nudge to /clear at (tokens)
nudge_at_tokens.description: When the main conversation's context passes this many tokens, expediter suggests /clear (free) over /compact. Set it to roughly where you'd compact by hand. Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 have a 1M window, so 40-50% is 400-500k; lower saves more usage.

checkpoint_max_age_hours.title: Checkpoint freshness (hours)
checkpoint_max_age_hours.description: After /clear or compaction, only a checkpoint updated within this many hours is re-injected.
